label: AUXILIARY_NONQCD_MET -- QCD ABSENT, NOT an all-background result, NOT numerically comparable to PRIMARY_BKG_N=110 models
interpretation: met_pt separates signal from ttbar+other_background reasonably well (AUC far from 0.5, background has systematically higher met_pt), but this cannot be folded into the PRIMARY 110-background ranking because QCD has no met_pt value at all. Any future model wanting to use met_pt would need a QCD-specific imputation/handling strategy, which is out of scope here.
